steps.title: The request arrives
steps.what: Cases measured in this flow: Allowed tool call, signed-in user (200); Allowed tool call, agent key (200); Tool call refused (tool not in grant) (403); App not granted (403); Tool list filtered to granted tools (200).

steps.title: The gateway forwards it
steps.what: The gateway forwards allowed calls to the MCP server and filters the tool list on the way back.

steps.title: Gateway pod log (cyonproxy.log): 14 lines
steps.what: 14 line(s) across 5 case(s). User and tool are logged. The decision is implied by the app-level permission line; no per-tool allow line. Email is blank. Arguments and the tool result are logged in full. The key name appears as the client. The user is the key custodian. The denial names the user, the app and agent=true. It does not name the tool. User, app and agent=true; no tool because none was requested. Every removed tool, prompt and resource is logged by name. The kept tools are not listed.

steps.title: PingGateway X-Gw-Audit-Trail header: not read back
steps.what: mcpAudit record with user, agent, tool, decision. Returned to the caller only; not stored. Not captured in this run. No reading of this sink was recorded for the MCP cases (UNVERIFIED).

steps.title: Console Activity Log and Agent Insights: not read back
steps.what: Local-proxy rows lack tool, decision and agent. Agent Insights shows AI Guard verdicts for LLM routes. Not re-checked for the cases here. No reading of this sink was recorded for the MCP cases (UNVERIFIED).
